name: ShareASale
description: ShareASale was an affiliate-marketing network for merchants and publishers, covering programs, affiliates, links, transactions, commissions, reporting, tracking, and product feeds before its migration into Awin.
agentUseSummary: ShareASale is not available as a new Relay connection because Awin officially closed the ShareASale platform on October 6, 2025 and moved upgraded advertisers to Awin. Relay will not collect legacy Merchant IDs, API Tokens, or API Secrets or build against a closed platform; customers should use a separately evaluated Awin provider instead.

providerSetup.blocker: Awin states the ShareASale platform officially closed on October 6, 2025. Upgraded ShareASale advertiser accounts now operate on Awin, and remaining ShareASale ecommerce plugins are maintenance-only; creating or validating a new ShareASale API connection would target a retired product.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep ShareASale unavailable and do not collect legacy credentials. Evaluate Awin as its own provider under Awin's current authentication, API, account-role, and production-acceptance contract; any customer account upgrade or data migration remains an external Awin workflow.

evidence.supports: Awin states that the ShareASale platform officially closed on October 6, 2025 and directs upgraded advertisers to review their new Awin account and set up APIs there.

Awin states the ShareASale plugin update window ended October 6, 2025, the Wix app was decommissioned, and remaining ShareASale Shopify, WooCommerce, and Shoplazza plugins are maintenance-only with features unavailable.
Awin's ShareASale upgrade collection consistently identifies the platform as closed and provides post-migration Awin guidance rather than a continuing ShareASale onboarding path.
